description.zh:
访问PrivateZone服务的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where you access the PrivateZone service.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.
The ID of the CEN instance.
The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is deployed.
The page number. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为**10**，取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-cen-private-zone-routes --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --access-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
